source:
@@U00476@@
Don't you hear?
Pleasure means nothing to me.
I dedicate myself herewith
to the frenzy of dissipation,
to joy that is pain, and pain joy,
to adoring hatred, and hatred that is love,
to torments that refresh, and refreshing exhaustion.
My soul healed of the lust for knowledge,
I lay myself open to the world’s pain and suffering.
In my innermost self
I will experience all that humankind experiences,
the heights and the depths,
the sorrows and delights,
and doing so expand myself to encompass
all of humanity, and, in the end,
shatter like a ship in a storm.

@@U00478@@
Oh, believe me,
I’ve gnawed away at these iron rations for millennia
and have learned only one thing:
there’s no man, none, from womb to tomb,
has ever digested this bitter dough!
Take it from one of us,
this totality of creation, the universe,
is made only for a god!
I's he who dwells in eternal light,
us he casts into darkness,
while you must make do with day and night.

@@U00480@@
But I will!

@@U00482@@
Good!
I like your spirit!
But there’s only one thing frightens me:
Time is short, my friend, and art is long.
translation:
@@U00476@@
你没听见吗？
快乐对我来说毫无意义。
我谨此献身
到疯狂的放荡，
快乐就是痛苦，痛苦就是快乐，
崇拜仇恨，而仇恨就是爱，
使人精神焕发的折磨，以及使人精神焕发的疲惫。
我的灵魂治愈了对知识的渴望，
我对世界的痛苦和磨难敞开心扉。
在我内心深处
我将经历人类所经历的一切，
高度和深度，
那些悲伤和欢乐，
并以此扩展自己的范围
全人类，并且最终，
像暴风雨中的船一样破碎。

@@U00478@@
哦，相信我，
我已经啃了这些铁口粮几千年了
并且只学到了一件事：
从子宫到坟墓，没有人，没有，
曾经消化过这个苦涩的面团！
从我们其中一个人那里拿走，
这个创造的整体，宇宙，
只为神而造！
我是住在永恒之光中的人，
他把我们扔进黑暗里，
而你必须白天和黑夜凑合着。

@@U00480@@
但我会的！

@@U00482@@
好！
我喜欢你的精神！
但只有一件事让我害怕：
时间很短，我的朋友，而艺术却很长。
